findings: Every final node strictly verifies 4096 rows in four batch calls and reuses 4096 rows during prepare; these samples show no additional strict verification caused by the early successor path.

Early body enqueue responsibility is observed: 6 / 9 / 6 peer obligations, 20630310 / 30945465 / 20630310 logical bytes. These are neither confirmed remote receipt nor physical wire/retransmission measurements.

Successor promoted counts are 2 / 3 / 2 with zero recorded discard. Counters combine local and remote origins, so remote-specific acceleration is not established; zero discard does not prove every early body was accepted.

Only CPU first-round node0 height4 executes before its parent ACK, by 223.4375ms. No before-parent completion is recorded in the other two rounds; early distribution is not equivalent to useful preexecution.

Final CPU first-round node3 height2 execution completes 727.5901ms after its parent ACK; node0/node1/node2 then wait 316.8565/316.0587/293.8116ms from local height3 execution completion to proposal receipt. This locates a surviving progression skew but does not identify its sole cause.

Final CPU repeat height2 execution is 567.0987/504.0267/523.5514ms after parent ACK at nodes1/2/3; node0 is already executed and waits 422.0325ms for that proposal. No round change or send expiry is recorded.

Stage1 diagnostic CPU/GPU/CPU TPS 2890.781259/2405.225258/2935.371658 and final 2189.245758/3061.100188/2323.615673 use different signed corpus/domain and separate process runs. They are stage observations, not a controlled before/after causal result.

For stage timestamps, null means the selected event was not recorded, not zero work or zero latency. Stage1 lookahead lacks some candidate_execution_done events. Timings are local monotonic observations; negative execution_to_proposal means proposal arrived before execution completed.

All three final diagnostic rounds passed cold recovery and full fee-state checks; the non-diagnostic paired samples remain the primary performance comparison. Neither these counters nor the improved GPU sample qualifies 12K or multihost performance.
